scope: Read-only live diagnosis and isolated extension/browser fixtures; no live service restart or execution command.
root_cause: Document status refresh reused the publishing action source builder. A publication error, including another tab holding the source lease, prevented the status read and the generic handler rendered every target offline. HTTP failures and network failures had the same label.

fix.reads: Compute the canonical version-2 source identity locally, with publication disabled, before reading the SQL-backed statuses.
fix.actions: Formalize, Stub and batch actions retain publication and current-publisher fencing.
fix.errors: HTTP errors render unavailable with their reason; transport errors render offline. Retry after five seconds or a longer server retry interval.
fix.boundary: No worker, workspace or editor callback bypass; no API, schema or process change.
fix.activation: Reload the unpacked extension and refresh the Overleaf tab. No stack restart is needed.

cases: Opening a document under another tab live publisher lease still reads statuses without publisher/publication calls
Version-2 source identity remains present in status requests
HTTP errors retain their reason and do not claim the service is offline
Network errors remain offline and recover after the next five-second retry
Explicit formalization still publishes immutable source with mirroring enabled or disabled
Concurrent batch preparation shares one publisher identity and ordered sequence
Chromium status polling preserves text selection and existing publisher ownership
Nine-target batch still waits for the active lease and submits one accepted operation
validation.release_scope: Development extension source qualification; no new production image qualification.
